title: Notify SafeWork NSW of an incident
summary: This page explains that certain workplace health and safety incidents must be reported immediately to SafeWork NSW.
intro:
By law, certain workplace health and safety incidents must be immediately reported to SafeWork NSW. These incidents may involve an employee, contractor or member of the public.

Significant penalties apply if you fail to report a notifiable incident.

Incidents you must report are:

Notify SafeWork NSW immediately when you become aware of a notifiable incident: call 13 10 50.

As well as providing first aid where required, you must also:

Visit SafeWork NSW Incident notification.
what_you_need: Be aware of a notifiable incident involving an employee, contractor, or member of the public.
